Stats Snack is a weekly meeting on Zoom for students and faculty at UMass Boston to discuss random topics, address questions, ask for advice, or attend/host workshops/talks related to statistics/anything data-related!

Spring 2026 regular meetings are **2pm on Thursdays**!

See [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U90DD1gmx9riJ2uYar72f_p2ifWZoKbu6zm7jRGefzI/edit?usp=sharing) for the weekly agenda. See [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1THMtCrVZ_MdzZd65zggxyFiAo9cfHvp4rMyUUUuKoUg/edit?usp=sharing) for the Spring 2026 schedule.
